mapper.sql: id,institution_id AS institutionId,settlement_type AS settlementType,period_key AS periodKey,status,amount_status AS amountStatus,gross_fen AS grossFen,commission_fen AS commissionFen,net_payable_fen AS netPayableFen,paid_fen AS paidFen,rule_version AS ruleVersion,verification_evidence AS verificationEvidence,created_at AS createdAt,updated_at AS updatedAt,version

id,settlement_batch_id AS settlementBatchId,redemption_id AS redemptionId,amount_status AS amountStatus,gross_fen AS grossFen,commission_fen AS commissionFen,payable_fen AS payableFen,rate_snapshot AS rateSnapshot,pending_reason AS pendingReason,created_at AS createdAt

id,settlement_batch_id AS settlementBatchId,amount_fen AS amountFen,bank_trade_no AS bankTradeNo,paid_at AS paidAt,voucher_file_id AS voucherFileId,evidence_ref AS evidenceRef,created_by AS createdBy,created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_settlement_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND institution_id=#{institutionId} AND settlement_type=#{type} AND period_key=#{periodKey}
SELECT FROM crm_settlement_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM crm_settlement_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_settlement_line (tenant_id,settlement_batch_id,redemption_id,amount_status,gross_fen,commission_fen,payable_fen,rate_snapshot,pending_reason) VALUES (#{tenantId},#{batchId},#{redemptionId},'PENDING_VERIFICATION',0,0,0,#{rateSnapshot},'结算金额与规则需财务人工核准')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_settlement_line WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND settlement_batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY redemption_id
SELECT FROM crm_settlement_line WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND redemption_id=#{redemptionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_settlement_batch SET status='CONFIRMED',amount_status='VERIFIED',gross_fen=#{grossFen}, commission_fen=#{commissionFen},net_payable_fen=#{netPayableFen},rule_version=#{ruleVersion}, verification_evidence=#{verificationEvidence},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='DRAFT' AND amount_status='PENDING_VERIFICATION'

UPDATE crm_settlement_batch SET paid_fen=#{paidFen},status=#{status},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND amount_status='VERIFIED' AND status IN ('CONFIRMED','PARTIALLY_PAID')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_settlement_payment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND bank_trade_no=#{bankTradeNo}
SELECT FROM crm_settlement_payment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND settlement_batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY id

SELECT 'ENTITLEMENT_LEDGER' AS checkType,e.id AS resourceId,NULL AS institutionId, e.available_count AS expectedCount,COALESCE(SUM(l.delta_count),0) AS actualCount, NULL AS expectedFen,NULL AS actualFen,'权益可用次数与账本累计不一致' AS detail FROM crm_entitlement e LEFT JOIN crm_entitlement_ledger l ON l.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND l.entitlement_id=e.id WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} GROUP BY e.id,e.available_count HAVING e.available_count != COALESCE(SUM(l.delta_count),0)

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'ORDER_PAYMENT_CASH' AS checkType,o.id AS resourceId,NULL AS institutionId,NULL AS expectedCount,NULL AS actualCount, o.paid_fen AS expectedFen,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status='CONFIRMED' THEN p.amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS actualFen, '订单实付与已确认支付流水不一致' AS detail FROM crm_order o LEFT JOIN crm_payment_txn p ON p.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND p.order_id=o.id WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} GROUP BY o.id,o.paid_fen HAVING o.paid_fen != COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status='CONFIRMED' THEN p.amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) ) payment_diff UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'ORDER_REFUND_CASH' AS checkType,o.id AS resourceId,NULL AS institutionId,NULL AS expectedCount,NULL AS actualCount, o.refunded_fen AS expectedFen,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rp.status='SUCCEEDED' THEN rp.amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) AS actualFen, '订单成功退款额与成功退款流水不一致' AS detail FROM crm_order o LEFT JOIN crm_refund r ON r.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND r.order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN crm_refund_payment rp ON rp.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND rp.refund_id=r.id WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} GROUP BY o.id,o.refunded_fen HAVING o.refunded_fen != COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rp.status='SUCCEEDED' THEN rp.amount_fen ELSE 0 END),0) ) refund_diff

SELECT 'REFUND_ALLOCATION' AS checkType,r.id AS resourceId,NULL AS institutionId,NULL AS expectedCount,NULL AS actualCount, r.succeeded_fen AS expectedFen,COALESCE(SUM(i.allocated_fen),0) AS actualFen,'成功退款额与权益现金分摊不一致' AS detail FROM crm_refund r LEFT JOIN crm_refund_item i ON i.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND i.refund_id=r.id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.status='SUCCEEDED' GROUP BY r.id,r.succeeded_fen HAVING r.succeeded_fen != COALESCE(SUM(i.allocated_fen),0)

SELECT 'SETTLEMENT_PAYMENT' AS checkType,b.id AS resourceId,b.institution_id AS institutionId,NULL AS expectedCount,NULL AS actualCount, b.paid_fen AS expectedFen,COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_fen),0) AS actualFen,'批次已付金额与付款流水不一致' AS detail FROM crm_settlement_batch b LEFT JOIN crm_settlement_payment p ON p.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND p.settlement_batch_id=b.id WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenantId} GROUP BY b.id,b.institution_id,b.paid_fen HAVING b.paid_fen != COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_fen),0)

SELECT 'UNBATCHED_REDEMPTION' AS checkType,r.id AS resourceId,r.institution_id AS institutionId, 1 AS expectedCount,0 AS actualCount,NULL AS expectedFen,NULL AS actualFen,'正式核销尚未进入结算批次' AS detail FROM crm_redemption r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.status='POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_settlement_line l WHERE l.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND l.redemption_id=r.id)
ORDER BY r.id
